newsitem.title: USA: Yes! Entertainment sees Q4 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Yes! Entertainment sees Q4 net loss.

text.p: Yes! Entertainment Corp said on Thursday it expects to post lower fourth quarter revenues compared to last year and a net loss for the period.
The company sees a fourth quarter net loss of $13.8 million, or $0.98 a share, based on about 14 million weighted average shares outstanding.
In the year-ago fourth quarter, Yes earned $4.3 million or $0.40 a share with about 10.8 million shares outstanding.
Revenues for the quarter fell to $19.0 million compared to $26.8 million last year.

For the year, Yes estimated revenues at about $69.1 million compared to $55.8 million last year. The net loss for the year will be about $12.5 million or $0.90 a share compared to net income of $3.5 million, or $0.55 a share last year.

The company cited a weak retail environment for toys, the timing of orders by retailers, and the delayed launch of its V-Link products for what its "extremely disappointing" fourth quarter performance, it said in a statement. It also said shipping of its T.R.A.P.S products and Power Penz Pen Phones had been delayed.
The revenue shortfall, combined with fixed expenses produced the net loss, the company said.
Looking to the future, the company said retail inventories of products are much lower than at the beginning of 1996 and "retail sell-through during January appears encouraging".
"We expect significant revenue growth in 1997 without a commensurate increase in fixed expenses," it said.
The company also said it raised $10 million through the sale of 5 percent convertible subordinated debentures and warrants in a private placement to institutional investors.
